newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thurday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.

Traders said major state banks lent out large amounts of money on the market today as during the past few days, depressing the rates. But non-bank financial institutions increased their borrowing, preventing the rates from dropping sharply, they said.

"Non-bank financial institutions increased their borrowing due to active domestic A share trading especially in Shenzhen," said one trader. "The borrowing is likely to continue to support the rates in the next few days, preventing them from plunging despite the recent bank interest rate cut," he added.
